summary: [probe] The prescribed remedy hides real notes: with no gating, an effective date in Detail is a finding, and brief-polish says to waive the rule 'in that section'. A detail holding '- 연체 요금은 2026-12-01부터 붙는다.' and '- 이 방식은 2026-09-14 회의에서 결정했다.' shows 2 findings; the waiver brief-polish shows ('연체 요금은 2026-12-01부터 적용되는 동작이다') clears both. Waivers are per rule and section, so every section with an effective date or deadline becomes blind to decision history.
